Subject: Sales -> CS handoff: CareValor pilot — action sheet & technical intake

Hi team,

Quick handoff for the CareValor pilot (deal CAREVAL-3245). Summary up top — they signed the SOW (attached v0.9) and committed to a 90-day pilot for a scoped cohort of 6 clinics (US-only). Key commercial/ops points:

- Pilot start window: target week of 2026-09-20.
- Billing: prepaid pilot credit (applied) — procurement contact in cc.
- Contract notes: standard Redwood Dedicated SLA for pilot is agreed; early termination clause trimmed to 30 days mutual notice.

Technical/implementation notes (from discovery):
- Deployment preference: Dedicated capacity in us-west with VPC peering to CareValor account.
- Data flow: inference-only; no logs retained long-term. CareValor requires audit logs for first 30 days (we agreed to provide token-level latency/cost reports).
- Network: IP allowlist required. They provided a topology (attached).
- Model: want a tuned open model variant (rwd-nucleus-1-small) with 8k context. Initial inference profile: 150 req/min bursting to 300 for short windows.
- Security: SOC2 required (we already provided SOC2 Type II PDF in sales pack).

Attached: CAREVAL_SOW_v0.9.pdf (redline), carevalor_network_topology_v1.png, mutual_action_plan.xlsx (initial timeline + milestone owners). HubSpot deal link in metadata.

Recommended next steps / asks for CS + Implementation:
1) Owner: Tessa to be primary Customer Success lead; Karthik to own implementation and infra coordination. Vanessa to support solution engineering and assist the first integration call.
2) Schedule a 60-min kickoff with CareValor (availability windows included in the MAP). Prefer week of 9/20.
3) Confirm IP allowlist, firewall rules, and preferred peering model by 9/10 so infra ticket can be opened.
4) Finalize SOW redlines and send DocuSign for signature (procurement@carevalor.com). Michael will follow up on signatures.

Internal notes: procurement expects standard onboarding credits; finance approved a one-off pilot discount tied to usage thresholds. Watch for any scope creep — their clinical team asked for a short eval of an HL7 connector but that’s out-of-scope for pilot (mark as backlog).

Assigning tentative owners here — please reply with confirmations and any blockers.

Cheers,

Michael Grant
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
